meta.storyTitle: test fixtures and assertions inside the named test files plus the probe helper edit

summary.prose: Revision 4 per review feedback (design unchanged since rev 2). Test-side-only fix of two vscode-plugin test defects, no product code changes. (1) docs-review-panel t3 compile probe: recorded failing diagnostics are exclusively node_modules .d.ts declaration-file errors, so the single correct compiler option is skipLibCheck. compileProbe (scripts/test-harness/probe.mjs:8-25) gains a narrow per-probe skipLibCheck?: boolean (default off; wiring pinned by the unit test in scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts:124, commit b23dd0e7e), and the panel call site passes skipLibCheck: true (commit 7a47d0e28). (2) commands.test.ts: full captured-sequence assertion matches the current controller contract: install [-y --target <root>], start/restart [--skip-sync --skip-install --skip-build], stop, update via installer [--migrate-runtime --no-start]. Acceptance mapping: ac1/ac2 are carried by the real-panel probe behavior test (scripts/__tests__/test-harness-probes.test.ts:13, which runs the two t3 tests under a nested harness and asserts 2 pass / 0 fail), with the stub test as wiring evidence; ac3 by the commands test. Harness evidence for the t3 tests on fix commit 7a47d0e28: .insrc/tmp/test-harness/runs/a76220f7-26a1-4d77-aa31-d08fc1886bcc and aa15f6e1-091d-4712-bce3-47ca8f728627 logs show 237 ok / 0 not ok individually (pre-fix run 4bde4114: not ok 78); the file-level pending-promise termination is tracked separately as ISSUE-4b33600426ce1112 and is not an individual test outcome.

dataModelChanges.details: Add optional skipLibCheck?: boolean (default false). When true the owned tsc argv gains --skipLibCheck; all other args, timeout, compiler-error and cleanup handling unchanged. Wiring pinned by the unit test in scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts:124 (commit b23dd0e7e).

testStrategy.testFramework: node:test. All subjects are gate-runnable (the build gate runs each mapped file via npx tsx --test-force-exit from the repo root) and also pass under the supported harness (npm test -- <file>, Node 22.22.1): scripts/__tests__/test-harness-probes.test.ts, scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts, and npm test -- --suite=vscode src/daemon/__tests__/commands.test.ts. Harness evidence for the t3 tests on fix commit 7a47d0e28: .insrc/tmp/test-harness/runs/a76220f7-26a1-4d77-aa31-d08fc1886bcc and aa15f6e1-091d-4712-bce3-47ca8f728627 (0-vscode-plugin_src_chat___tests___docs-review-panel.test.ts.log) show 237 ok / 0 not ok individually; pre-fix run 4bde4114 showed not ok 78. The file-level pending-promise termination of that file under the harness is tracked separately as ISSUE-4b33600426ce1112 and is not an individual test outcome.

testLevels.purpose: All three subjects are gate-runnable. The stub test (test-harness.test.ts:124) pins the skipLibCheck argv wiring (default off, appended only when set). The commands test pins the full owned-runtime argv sequence (ac3).
